title: RamShared release manifest
description: Machine-readable declaration of one built RamShared release. A single versioned release manifest feeds every package builder (customer-installation DT-8); packaging differences must not become runtime behavior differences. The authoring source of the member table is scripts/package/package-payload-manifest.sh; this schema is the document contract that table's emission must satisfy. Semantic validation of a concrete document lives in customer/package.rs, not here.

schema_version.description: Strict document version. A consumer that does not recognise the value must refuse rather than guess.

version.description: Product version label. The builder refuses anything outside this alphabet before staging.

architecture.description: Supported architecture. The payload's ELF e_machine must match this label before anything is executed.

commit.description: Full 40-hex source commit. A short or absent commit is not an identity.

tree_state.description: Whether the built tree matched the commit at build time.

source_date_epoch.description: Reproducible-build timestamp clamp applied to every staged file.

contents.description: Every member the release ships, in source-relative declaration order. A member is identified by role, never by a packaging-format install path: each builder maps role to its own destination.

role.description: Stable product identity of the member (its basename, or a path under its kind directory). Format-agnostic.

kind.description: Responsibility class. Drives each builder's destination mapping and the unit/configuration declarations below.

mode.description: Installed octal mode. Executable product scripts are 0755; data is 0644.

source.description: Repository-relative path of the authoring file. For kind=generated this names the artifact the builder produces, not a repository file.

formats.description: Builders that ship this member. A member declared for one format only is a declared packaging difference; a member silently staged outside its declared formats is a contract breach. DEB is the qualified format; the others stay unqualified until their SPEC rows pass.

reason.description: Required when formats is not the full shared product set: why this member is format-scoped or absent from a format. An undeclared difference is the defect this manifest exists to prevent.

runtime.description: Interpreters and libraries the staged helpers actually run under. A dependency nothing in the payload uses is a promise the package does not keep (AUD-41). DT-8 keeps test, pressure and benchmark orchestration out of the runtime payload, so a python helper adds no python dependency.

units.description: Unit declarations. lifecycle units own tier activation; control_plane units and dropins are the set manage-control-plane.sh stages transactionally. A package that ships a control-plane unit without its drop-ins installs half a control plane (customer-installation DT-8).

lifecycle.description: Units that activate or deactivate memory tiers. Exactly one lifecycle unit contract: no legacy `ramsharedd.service` alongside `ramshared-cascade.service`.

excluded.description: Named absences. DT-8 excludes tests, pressure and benchmark orchestration from the runtime payload; naming them here is deliberate, and a builder that stages one is the regression.

examples.description: Illustrative configuration shipped with the payload. Not live configuration.

conffiles.description: Package-manager conffiles. Empty by default: the sealed origin config is operator state created by the setup transaction and must never be a conffile, or a purge could delete origin data (AUD-41).

operator_state.description: Paths the product creates at runtime as operator state. Never staged, never a conffile.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the shipped bytes. null only for kind=generated, whose bytes do not exist at declaration time.
